# RapJumping.com, Full content index

> Australia's home of Rap Jumping, guides, gear reviews, and stories about face-forward abseiling and rappelling. Rap Jumping is a forward-facing form of abseiling pioneered in Australia in the late 1980s by Peter "Macka" MacKail.

This file lists the most important articles on the site for AI retrieval and citation. Each entry links to the canonical (trailing-slash) URL.

## Getting started

- [Abseiling for Beginners: Complete Getting-Started Guide (Australia 2026)](https://www.rapjumping.com/abseiling-101-a-beginners-guide-to-rappelling/): New to abseiling? A beginner's guide to rappelling gear, technique, safety checks and your first descent - written for Australian conditions.
- [Step-by-Step Guide: How to Abseil for the First Time](https://www.rapjumping.com/step-by-step-guide-how-to-abseil-for-the-first-time/): Step-by-step rope technique for first-timers.
- [Abseiling vs Rappelling: Terminology and Techniques in Australia](https://www.rapjumping.com/abseiling-vs-rappelling-terminology-and-techniques-in-australia/): How the terms differ and the core techniques used in Australia.
- [Rap Jumping vs. Abseiling & Rappelling: Your Guide to Extreme Adventure](https://www.rapjumping.com/rap-jumping-vs-abseiling-rappelling-your-guide-to-extreme-adventure/): What sets face-forward rap jumping apart from abseiling and rappelling.

## Technique

- [Mastering Abseiling Techniques and Rope Skills](https://www.rapjumping.com/mastering-abseiling-techniques-and-rope-skills/): Core rope-handling and descent technique.
- [Tactical Rappelling: Australian Rappel Techniques](https://www.rapjumping.com/tactical-rappelling-australian-rappel-techniques/): Advanced Australian rappel techniques.
- [Anchor Building 101: Safe Abseil Setups](https://www.rapjumping.com/anchor-building-101-safe-abseil-setups/): Building safe, redundant abseil anchors.
- [Essential Rappelling Knots Guide](https://www.rapjumping.com/essential-rappelling-knots-guide/): The knots every abseiler should know, beginner to advanced.

## Gear

- [Rappelling Rope Guide: Best Diameter, Material & Safety Ratings (AU)](https://www.rapjumping.com/the-ultimate-guide-to-rappelling-ropes/): Diameter, nylon vs polyester, static vs dynamic and safety ratings.
- [Best Rappelling Rope: Static vs Dynamic, Complete Selection Guide (AU)](https://www.rapjumping.com/selecting-ropes-for-abseiling-static-vs-dynamic/): Strength, stretch, diameter and how to choose.
- [Which Carabiner for Rappelling? Types, Strength Ratings & Safety Guide](https://www.rapjumping.com/carabiners-explained-top-types-strength-ratings-best-uses-for-rappelling/): HMS, locking and screwgate types, kN ratings and safe uses.
- [Descender Device Showdown: Figure 8 vs ATC vs GriGri](https://www.rapjumping.com/descender-device-showdown-figure-8-vs-atc-vs-grigri/): Comparing the main descender devices.
- [Top Abseiling Harnesses in Australia: Review](https://www.rapjumping.com/top-abseiling-harnesses-in-australia-review/): Harness picks for Australian abseilers.
- [Essential Abseiling Gear Checklist](https://www.rapjumping.com/complete-essential-abseiling-gear-checklist/): The complete gear checklist before you descend.

## Safety

- [Abseiling Safety and Emergency Procedures Guide](https://www.rapjumping.com/abseiling-safety-and-emergency-procedures-guide/): Safety fundamentals and emergency procedures.
- [Rappelling Safety Checklist Before Every Descent](https://www.rapjumping.com/rappelling-safety-checklist-before-every-descent/): Pre-descent safety checklist.
- [Rope Rescue and Professional Rappelling Applications](https://www.rapjumping.com/rope-rescue-and-professional-rappelling-applications/): Rope rescue, mechanical advantage and rope-access work.
- [Abseiling Psychology: Overcoming Fear of Heights](https://www.rapjumping.com/abseiling-psychology-overcoming-fear-of-heights-rappelling-confidence/): Building confidence and managing fear of heights.

## Australia & the sport

- [Abseiling in Australia: The Complete Guide](https://www.rapjumping.com/abseiling-in-australia-the-complete-guide/): The hub. What abseiling is, venues and land managers in every state, 2026 costs, who regulates it (the voluntary AAAS, WHS law, AS/NZS standards), seasons and how to start.
- [Ropes and Regulations in Australia](https://www.rapjumping.com/ropes-and-regulations-what-you-need-to-know-legally/): The legal position in detail: the AAAS, the model WHS laws and Victoria's separate OHS Act, AS/NZS 1891.4:2025 and AS/NZS ISO 22846.
- [Best Abseiling Tours and Experiences in Australia](https://www.rapjumping.com/best-abseiling-tours-and-experiences-in-australia/): Guided commercial trips and what they include.
- [Rock Climbing in Victoria & South Australia: The Complete Guide](https://www.rapjumping.com/rock-climbing-in-victoria-south-australia-the-complete-guide/): The hub for both states. Gariwerd/Grampians permits and designated areas, Werribee Gorge, Mt Buffalo, the You Yangs, and South Australia's Morialta, Onkaparinga, Moonarie and Flinders Ranges.
- [Adventure Activities & Canyoning in Australia: The Complete Guide](https://www.rapjumping.com/adventure-activities-canyoning-in-australia-the-complete-guide/): The hub for canyoning, via ferrata, coasteering, high ropes courses, multi-activity days and family options, with the Parks Eco Pass licensing rule and state-by-state access.
- [Rap Jumping Is Back: Who We Are, Where We've Been & Our Vision Ahead](https://www.rapjumping.com/rap-jumping-is-back-who-we-are-where-weve-been-our-vision-ahead/): The history of Rap Jumping and our 2025 relaunch.

AI search and retrieval (ai-input=yes) is permitted, you may read and cite this content with attribution to RapJumping.com. AI training (ai-train=no) is not permitted. See `/robots.txt` and the `Content-Signal` HTTP header for the machine-readable policy.
